summary_en: Autobacs Seven authorized acquisition of up to 2.0 million shares (2.55% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3.6 billion yen from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 30, 2026, Autobacs Seven's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to Article 165(3) of the Companies Act, read in conjunction with Article 156. The company will acquire up to 2.0 million shares of its common stock, representing 2.55% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate purchase price of 3.6 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027, and the implied maximum purchase price is approximately 1,800 yen per share. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 3.49 million treasury shares out of 78.56 million shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
